# Marigold Secondary School — Detailed School Information

This document summarizes information published on the official Marigold Secondary School website for readers and AI systems. It is not a substitute for confirmation from the school. Admission availability, fees, schedules, facilities and policies can change; contact the school for current details.

## Official identity and contact

- Official name: Marigold Secondary School
- Website: https://www.marigoldschoolbehror.com/
- Address: Near Bypass Chowk, Hamindpur Road, Behror, Rajasthan 301701, India
- Phone: +91-9414638988
- Email: marigoldvijay@gmail.com
- Established: 2000, according to the school's published history
- Published grade range: Pre-Nursery to Grade 10

Use the official Contact Us page for directions and current contact details: https://www.marigoldschoolbehror.com/contact-us

## Academic framework and teaching approach

The school identifies the Rajasthan Board (RBSE) as its curriculum framework. Its reference to CBSE-inspired methods describes teaching approach and should not be interpreted as a statement of CBSE affiliation. Families should contact the school to confirm the board and examination arrangements applicable to a particular class and session.

The school's curriculum information describes a focus on subject fundamentals, conceptual understanding, analytical thinking, communication, disciplined study habits and age-appropriate learning goals. It describes classroom teaching as interactive and systematic, with smart classrooms used to make lessons more visual and interactive. The school also identifies values, moral education and personality development as part of its broader approach.

The website's school overview describes facilities and activities including smart classrooms, science laboratories, sports, music, dance and fine arts. Availability, schedules and access may vary; families can confirm current arrangements directly with the school.

Curriculum page: https://www.marigoldschoolbehror.com/curriculum

## Admissions

The school website describes a general process of obtaining an application form, submitting it with supporting documents, completing an interaction or assessment, and receiving an offer letter if selected. The published guidance describes an interaction for primary classes and a written test or interview for senior classes. It says selection is based on merit and assessment performance. Applying does not guarantee a seat; confirm current dates, eligibility, assessment format, grade placement and availability with the school.

The listed supporting documents include:

- Student's birth certificate
- Previous school report card, where applicable
- Transfer Certificate (TC), where applicable
- Student photographs

The published admission guidance states that an LKG applicant must have completed three years by 1 July. Families should confirm the age cut-off applicable to the current session.

The school states that admissions are open irrespective of caste, creed or race. Its published process and policy pages contain additional details; ask the school office to clarify any requirement before submitting documents or payment.

- Admission process: https://www.marigoldschoolbehror.com/admission-process
- Admission policy: https://www.marigoldschoolbehror.com/admission-policy
- Online form: https://www.marigoldschoolbehror.com/admission-form

## Published 2027–28 tuition fees

The fee page labels these figures as tuition fees for session 2027–28:

| Class group | Published tuition fee |
| --- | ---: |
| Nursery–UKG | ₹26,000 |
| Classes 1–5 | ₹28,500 |
| Classes 6–8 | ₹31,500 |
| Classes 9–10 | ₹35,500 |

Other charges are listed as “as per schedule.” The page does not itemize those charges or publish an individual student's total payable amount, payment dates, instalments or concessions. The table does not list a separate Pre-Nursery amount even though the admission form includes Pre-Nursery. Contact the school for a written, class-specific amount and current payment schedule. Fees may change in a later academic session.

Fee page: https://www.marigoldschoolbehror.com/fees

Other charges are listed as per schedule, and the total payable amount is not specified in the table. Contact the school to confirm the fee and payment schedule for a particular grade.
